title: Shared per-view HUD
summary: Optional instruments with independent per-view lifetimes.

blocks.text: Create one HUD per logical view, including the first seat. Supply distinct seat/player/target/viewport identities, an opaque session/context token and exact-version read-only adapters. Select compatible instrument definitions; absent adapters omit that instrument. Reflow resizes retained instances. Target/session changes cancel all gestures before rebinding any instrument; join/leave creates/disposes only affected views. Optional absence attaches no instruments. Dispose view/provider resources on removal. No world step or hard-coded flight instrument exists in the lifecycle manager.
